hotspots.label: Inspect the Old Dock Mark
hotspots.message: A broken-circle hammer is worn into the stone. The Dockmaster says it has outlasted every storm. For a moment, the river feels warm.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.label: Talk to Mira
npcs.message: Mara says a town begins with a warm table. I say it begins with someone carrying the bread. Meet Toma at the Pet Center and our Dockmaster, then choose a home. We have room for another neighbor.

npcs.name: Toma
npcs.label: Talk to Toma
npcs.message: That puppy keeps popping up to greet everyone, and the cat pretends she is not watching. Your own companion is welcome too. A home and a little care can make even a restless creature feel safe.

npcs.name: Dockmaster
npcs.label: Talk to Dockmaster
npcs.message: The new fishing outfitter is open, and the path to Shadow Woods is clear. Bring your catches home. See that hammer mark by the quay? The old builders left us more than sturdy stone.
